claims: The 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game took place on Saturday, March 28, 2026.
The 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game took place at Memorial Stadium, Lincoln, Nebraska.
The Red Team defeated the White Team 22-17 in the 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game.
Head coach Matt Rhule summarized the atmosphere of the 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game as "quiet and focused".
Quarterback Anthony Colandrea made his debut for the Red Team in the 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game.
The 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game had standard scoring.
The 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game had 15-minute quarters.
The 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game had a running clock.
Defensive lineman Anthony Jones missed the 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game to be with his newborn, according to the Omaha World-Herald.
